Cost: 1 holy pool point

Benefit: The paladin conjures a brilliant light that shields nearby allies. Allies within 30 feet, excluding the paladin herself, gain temporary hit points equal to 1d6 + an additional 1d6 per two paladin levels attained after 3rd (2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 7th, and so on) and also gain an amount of DR/– equal to half of the paladin's Charisma modifier (minimum 1). These benefits last for a number of rounds equal to the paladin's Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
